counter_arguments: The PR only adds a new metrics module; it does not modify or remove the in‑memory tax cache implementation shown in the workaround.
There is no change to the _tax_cache, _cache_times, or TAX_CACHE_TTL variables, nor any logic that would conditionally disable caching based on API latency.
The revisit condition requires the tax provider API latency to be reliably below 200 ms; the PR does not measure, monitor, or act on that latency metric.
The PR’s purpose is to track charge success/failure counts and webhook processing times, which is unrelated to tax rate retrieval or caching behavior.
Even if the new metrics could be used to observe latency, the PR does not contain any code that uses those metrics to decide when to drop the cache, so the workaround remains in place.
reasoning: The PR introduces unrelated metrics counters and a timer utility. It makes no modifications to the tax caching logic, does not address the latency threshold condition, and provides no mechanism to retire the cache when the API becomes fast. Therefore it does not satisfy the revisit condition for HACK-012.
